How NestMatch works

Is NestMatch free for renters and landlords?

Yes. The available tools are free to use. NestMatch does not collect booking commissions, rent, application fees, or subscription payments. Original listing providers may have their own charges; check their terms.

Can I organize a housing search in any city?

Yes. Use My rental links to manually save public listing links from any location and enter your own details. Cost fields use U.S. dollars. The separate live feed currently covers Pensacola, Florida, and is not a search of every rental platform.

Can I apply or contact a landlord here?

Open a saved listing's source link to inquire or apply on the original site. NestMatch does not send applications, messages, or booking requests.

Are my saved places public?

No. Your saves and notes stay in this browser profile. The organizer can download and restore a private backup; there is no account or cloud sync. Read our privacy notice.
